title: Rear screen (LCD) at 3:2 in movie mode with the focus frames: VDF fills the 3:2 panel with the 16:9 live view, and the frame widgets expect the live view there (ZV-E1 2.02 port)
artifact: cpapp-b.bin, its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the word is in the file, the change is made in RAM only
table: VDF fit-mode table 0x1e4bc8 and the frame widgets' rectangle tables 0xd7b560, 0xd7b5d8, 0xd7b650 (entry: rear panel, 16:9) [A7 IV addresses; ZV-E1: fit table 0x1f5c84 (function 0x1f5c34), frame tables 0xe9b3e0 (AfWindow), 0xe9b458 (TrackingFrame)]

summary.replaces: lcdfill_v1, with which no focus frame is drawn on the rear screen (F966)

sites.note: VDF fit mode for a 16:9 picture on a 3:2 panel (table for picture code 2, entry for panel code 1): 3 letterbox to 0 fill. The rear screen then shows the squeezed 16:9 live view over the whole 3:2 panel, i.e. stretched x32/27 vertically [A7 IV 0x1e4bcc]

cpActAfWindow (focus area frames), check 0x59f568 -> 0x128438: expected live-view rectangle for a 16:9 picture on the rear panel, x, y: stock letterbox (0, 38, 640, 404) to the whole panel (0, 0, 640, 480) [A7 IV 0xd7b5a0]

cpActAfWindow (focus area frames), check 0x59f568 -> 0x128438: expected live-view rectangle for a 16:9 picture on the rear panel, w, h: stock letterbox (0, 38, 640, 404) to the whole panel (0, 0, 640, 480) [A7 IV 0xd7b5a4]

cpActTrackingFrame (tracking and face frames), check 0x1297e8: expected live-view rectangle for a 16:9 picture on the rear panel, x, y: stock letterbox (0, 38, 640, 404) to the whole panel (0, 0, 640, 480) [A7 IV 0xd7b690]

cpActTrackingFrame (tracking and face frames), check 0x1297e8: expected live-view rectangle for a 16:9 picture on the rear panel, w, h: stock letterbox (0, 38, 640, 404) to the whole panel (0, 0, 640, 480) [A7 IV 0xd7b694]

left_out.why: cpActAfWindowRemoteSend and its rectangle table (A7 IV 0xd7b5d8) do not exist in the ZV-E1 2.02 firmware

checked_against: cpapp-b.bin 2.02: fit function and tables byte-identical to the A7 IV's (0x1e4b78 -> 0x1f5c34), both frame tables byte-identical to 0xd7b560
the two checks that read the frame tables aligned with the A7C II's (build/diff_consts.py): same row computation and aspect index table
not_shown: that the ZV-E1's rear panel is panel code 1 (3:2): Sony's specification (1,036,800 dots = 720 x 480); the run-time panel type byte is 0x1a71840
that the frame widgets use row 1 on this body (carried over from the A7 IV)
